$comment: Deterministic gates. CLAUDE.md asks the agent to run these; a hook makes it
impossible not to. Principle #21/#23 are enforced here rather than trusted.
Stop  — fires when the agent finishes a turn. Runs only the gates the current
changes require (scripts/verify-changed.sh scopes by git status), so
the fast path stays seconds, not the ~4 minutes a full run costs.
PreToolUse — blocks the two destructive patterns that actually bit us:
writing outside the repo, and rm -rf on a working tree.
